CBS announced the cancellation in July 2025, citing financial reasons. While there is speculation about political motivations related to Colbert's Trump criticism, CBS has maintained the May 2026 end date. Multiple snippets from late January 2026 confirm Colbert is still on air and preparing for the May finale. There is no evidence of CBS moving to terminate the show earlier than planned.
